## Appearance

Davy is a handsome child with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. His face features a snub nose and a single dimple in one cheek.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a highly energetic and mischievous individual whose lively face often reflects his playful nature. Characterized by a heedless, forgetful, and practical disposition, he lacks imagination and frequently makes faces at others. He possesses a deeply inquisitive and curious mind, constantly asking questions that can be difficult to answer, and he is known to tease those around him. Looking to the future, he aspires to live to be a hundred years old and desires to become a storekeeper so he can keep plenty of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +6 more_

## History

Davy Keith was an orphan whose father died when he was a baby, and he grew up with little upbringing prior to being taken in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) alongside his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md). A mischievous child, Davy quickly established a habit of playing pranks—such as putting a caterpillar down a girl's dress, tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed—before confiding his antics in [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). After he locked [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse and lied about it, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) held a heart-to-heart conversation with him to teach him the wrongness of lying. Over time, Davy continued to cause minor chaos, accidentally ruining lemon pies meant for a visiting author and suffering jealousy when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spent time with other children. His position at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was made permanent after his uncle [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) passed away and left money in trust for the twins. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) left for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Davy stayed behind with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), maintaining a close bond with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through letters and her holiday visits. During those visits, Davy often relied on [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to process his misdeeds, confessing to her after lying to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to cover up skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing. As he grew older, Davy continued to entertain [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with his chatter regarding school, town gossip, and his childhood plans for the future.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), +810 more_

## Quotes

> "You don’t look like a lady who’d whip a little boy just ’cause he couldn’t keep still. Didn’t you find it awful hard to keep still when you was only ‘s old as me?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "You was a girl once, I s’pose, though it’s awful funny to think of it. Dora can sit still . . . but there ain’t much fun in it I don’t think. Seems to me it must be slow to be a girl. Here, Dora, let me liven you up a bit."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)

> "Marilla washed it yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scoured me with hard soap the day of the funeral. That’s enough for one week. I don’t see the good of being so awful clean. It’s lots more comfable being dirty."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "But it was such a jolly big caterpillar . . . I picked him up on the church steps just as we went in. It seemed a pity to waste him. And say, wasn’t it fun to hear that girl yell?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> “I . . . did something else today,” went on Davy in a muffled voice. “I’m sorry now but I’m awful scared to tell you. You won’t be very cross, will you? And you won’t tell Marilla, will you?”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when he and his twin sister arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following their mother's funeral, and she quickly became a fond companion and teacher to him. Though he frequently causes trouble with misbehavior—such as hiding a toad in Marilla's bed or locking his sister away—he turns to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to confess his misdeeds. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses gentle heart-to-heart conversations to discipline him, helping Davy learn lessons about honesty while guiding his upbringing alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

- Friend of — fond companion  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014), [v3 ch.Transgressors P83](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0083), +1 more</sub>
- Student of  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister, brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) together after the death of their mother. Davy frequently targets [Dora](../character/dora.md) with mischievous pranks, such as tricking her into falling into a pigpen and locking her inside a toolhouse. Despite his teasing and occasional jealousy when she receives attention, they share their daily life, outings, and upbringing in the same household.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +9 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Davy came under Marilla's care at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after being brought there following his mother's funeral. His energetic, prankish behavior—including placing a toad in her bed and causing frantic searches around the farm—presents a constant disciplinary challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Though she must frequently punish and manage his antics, she works alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to figure out how best to raise him.

- Serves under  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P58](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0058), [v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--milty-boulter.md)

Davy and Milty are childhood friends who enjoy going fishing together. Their acquaintance forms part of Davy's social circle as he grows up and attends school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Friend of — friends who go fishing together (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)</sub>
